explication: Vince is a self-hosted web analytics service. The principal workflow is browser tracking into the server, event processing and storage, then dashboard/API queries that return analytics. The README also documents administration, shared dashboards, TLS, and tracking capabilities. The excerpts establish API routing, query handling, aggregation, session middleware, and time-series persistence; event-ingestion wiring and several UI/runtime connections are not shown, so those links are marked unverified or omitted.
